title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
author: Joseph Murphy
engineRationale: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind explores internal cognitive machinery, autosuggestion, the pre-sleep hypnagogic state, and emotional self-talk. It centers on an Everyman protagonist navigating internal friction, doubts, and subconscious reprogramming without specific historical figures to depict. Antidote's flat-vector Everyman rig + kinetic typography provides high emotional resonance and dynamic visual metaphors for psychological concepts.
